title: Senco Gold reports record festive retail sales of over ₹2,426 crore #Shorts
description:
Senco Gold says it recorded its highest-ever retail net sales value of over ₹2,426 crore in the 41-day festive period from 1 October to 11 November 2026, as reported by Business Standard.

Sources: Business Standard
